## Checklist

- [ ] `go vet ./... && go test ./...` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (store, HTTP, or an `httptest` fixture for a plugin)
- [ ] No secrets, personal addresses or hostnames in code, tests or docs (use `192.168.1.x` / `example.com`)
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if it is user-visible
